sourceNotes: 新增默认启用的实验性命令栏，支持搜索功能与执行常用操作，可通过应用内快捷键 ⌘⇧P 打开
音频新增麦克风静音与切换输出设备快捷操作，支持自定义全局快捷键，并可置顶常用应用的音量控制
防休眠支持拔掉电源或低电量时自动停止，可分别按需开启
日历日程显示起止时间，支持左右方向键翻月和空格返回今天
出口与分流支持按分类查看网站检测结果，并补充更多检测站点
修复 DNS 检测响应过大导致失败的问题，并完善本机 DNS 解析检测

en: Add an experimental Command Bar, enabled by default, to search features and run common actions. Open it with Command-Shift-P in the app.
Add actions to toggle microphone mute and cycle audio outputs, with customizable global shortcuts, and pin frequently used apps in volume controls.
Optionally stop Keep Awake when power is unplugged or the battery is low. Each option can be enabled separately.
Show event start and end times in the calendar. Use the left and right arrow keys to switch months and Space to return to today.
Group website tests by category in Egress & Routing and add more test sites.
Fix DNS tests failing on oversized responses and improve tests of local DNS resolution.
